query: ALTER TABLE audit_log ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_pkey PRIMARY KEY(id), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_workspace_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspace(id), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_resource_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resource(id), ADD CONSTRAINT audit_log_credential_id_fkey FOREIGN KEY(credential_id) REFERENCES credential(credential_id);
